import sys

def max_value(A, B):
    sum_val = A + B
    diff_val = A - B
    prod_val = A * B
    
    return max(sum_val, diff_val, prod_val)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    input_line = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    A, B = map(int, input_line.split())
    result = max_value(A, B)
    print(result)
